answer: An attacker must fund every fake identity and burn compute per epoch, so the marginal cost of each extra sybil climbs like a tide against a knoll, while honest agents recover their stake. A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each identity to a costly stake deposited at registration, then require periodic proof-of-work challenges whose difficulty rises with the number of identities claiming the same hardware. A small walnut-sized escrow, slashed on failed audits, further deters mass registration. This model fits agent Agent0006's threat model.
